selection.selection_rule: Auxiliary latency variant: keep the existing window SFT development-selected checkpoint unchanged; integrate the numerically verified static-window graph approach. Primary quality candidate remains classification_rl/full. No additional training or sealed-test-based checkpoint selection.
selection.streaming_scope: Existing window weights passed token-ID 8K and baseline text streaming audits; integrated graph text runtime still requires its separate final L20 validation.

startup.capture_seconds_scope: sum of per-length warmup, capture and state restoration; seed prefill excluded
startup.shared_memory_scope: one model-shared engine with 32 private graph arenas/pools; allocation deltas exclude pre-existing model allocations and are not per-session cache size
startup.eager_scope: prefix shorter than 512 or input block larger than 32 tokens
startup.allocation_scope: Model already loaded; graph initialization only. Shared arenas/pools are not session caches.

eager.scope: External wall clock around complete append_text; includes full retokenization, cache/snapshot clones, rollback/replay, both CPU-visible risk heads and return construction. Same loaded W512 weights, text trace and independent full-trace warmup. Excludes loading, startup capture, session prefill, diagnostics, HTTP and input waiting. Numerator is accepted net native tokens; replay and auxiliary startup tokens are separate.

graph.scope: External wall clock around complete append_text; includes full retokenization, cache/snapshot clones, rollback/replay, both CPU-visible risk heads and return construction. Same loaded W512 weights, text trace and independent full-trace warmup. Excludes loading, startup capture, session prefill, diagnostics, HTTP and input waiting. Numerator is accepted net native tokens; replay and auxiliary startup tokens are separate.

performance_comparison.limitation: One sequential 128-append measurement per engine; not a randomized concurrency or service-load benchmark.
